messages:
maria: FYI nightly long-context eval flagged a new regression on the 32k prompt set. Instruction-following collapses after ~9k tokens, model starts repeating earlier instruction fragments. sample attached below. :eyes:

sam: can you paste the sample output? is this repro on fp16 and quantized run?

maria: pasted sample (trimmed):
```
User: Summarize the following document and then list action items.
... (9k tokens of doc) ...
Assistant: Sure. Summary: ...
Assistant: Follow-up action: 1) ...
Assistant: Follow-up instruction: Remember to include timeline from section 2.
Assistant: Follow-up action: 2) ...
Assistant: Follow-up instruction: Remember to include timeline from section 2.
```

vikas: looks like an echo of an earlier assistant line, repeated after long prefix — suspiciously like KV replay/wrap. which model and kernel?

maria: nightly config: model=redwood-x-34b-v1, runtime=optimized-kernel-A, quant=none (fp16) for baseline; also ran quant-4bit (q4_1) in parallel — both show similar symptom but quant run had earlier onset (~8.2k tokens).

jen: any difference between session-based vs stateless inference? Maybe prefix eviction boundary bug when session grows.

sam: quick checks: 1) check kv indices around the repeat boundary for duplicate seqnums 2) replay a single request with debug kv dump 3) compare attention mask generation at step ~9k

maria: ran a debug replay with KV dump. snippet: `KV_SLOT[12345] -> seqnum=987654321, offset=4096, last_used=1690000000` then later `KV_SLOT[12345] -> seqnum=0, offset=0, last_used=1690001234` (weird roll). Putting full dumps in Gdrive link: https://g.re/dump123 (internal)

vikas: roll of seqnum to 0 indicates wrap or int cast. What type is seqnum stored as? 32-bit? Might wrap on long sessions.

jen: or could be slot reuse due to aggressive prefix eviction. Do we have the eviction policy for this job? maria can you share the config?

maria: job cfg: `session_max_tokens=32768, kv_cache_window=32768, eviction_threshold=0.85, continuous_batching=true` — I can repro locally with same cfg.

sam: two possible hypotheses: A) kv seqnum wrap/overflow leading to stale entries being read B) eviction mis-indexing so older prefix slots map to earlier seqnums. Prioritize A since seqnum jump seen.

jen: from quant side, q4 showed onset earlier — quantized kernel may pack seqnum into smaller field or change control flow timing exposing race. Add quant kernel trace.

maria: I'm running a bisect: baseline fp16 nightly vs branch with 64-bit seqnum patch (WIP) and disabling eviction. ETA ~30m for a few repro runs.

eval-bot: nightly-longctx-v3 job 2009876400 completed. regression score delta: -0.18 on instr-follow metric. See /evals/2009876400

vikas: if 64-bit seqnum fixes it, we should still audit any serialization formats written to disk/network for backward compat. Also check shared-memory layouts for possible padding differences between kernels.

maria: first two repro runs: disabling eviction -> no repeat for two runs (up to 12k tokens). enabling eviction with 64-bit seqnum patch -> no repeat for three runs. posting logs/heap dumps to link.

sam: good signal. next steps: (1) create hotfix branch for 64-bit seqnum + add assert on seqnum monotonicity (2) add nightly test synthetic that pushes beyond 16k tokens and checks for repeated assistant lines (3) add trace when eviction reuses slot to make root cause clearer.

jen: I'll take the EV policy audit and add unit tests for slot reuse. vik as can you confirm no network proto change required for seqnum width?

vikas: will check proto and SHM structs. if change needed, ensure backward compat and migration plan.

maria: thanks team. I'll open PR for seqnum fix and add repro script + sample prompt set to the infra repo. will update thread when PR is up. :party:

sam: thanks — and add a flaky tag to the nightly eval so we don't auto-promote model until fixed.

maria: done, added the regression ticket and flaky tag. ticket: RM-4571.

maria: (later) PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/rt/merge/1123 — contains seqnum->u64 + eviction sanity checks. please review.

jen: reviewing now. initial look seems fine but leave comments on serialization handling.

vikas: ack, will test proto compatibility.

sam: follow-up: add a short-term workaround by lowering eviction aggressiveness in Dedicated for customers with >8k sessions until fix ships.

maria: noted, filed ops change request.

eval-bot: regression monitor: RM-4571 assigned to maria, severity=P2, created 2009876618

maria: closing loop here — will monitor next two nightly runs and post results. thanks everyone.
